'''Brian Garrison''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Bravo 14 from Tempe, Arizona.<ref name="smlist" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service

| Decipher era || [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Bravo 14 (Tempe, Az)<ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
